mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `family_checkin` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId}) AS `checkinTotal`, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(`streak`), 0) FROM `family_checkin` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId}) AS `checkinMaxStreak`, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`change`), 0) FROM `family_points_record` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `change` > 0) AS `pointsEarned`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `content_blog` WHERE `author_id` = #{userId} AND `deleted` = 0 AND `status` = 'PUBLISHED') AS `blogCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `content_diary` WHERE `author_id` = #{userId} AND `deleted` = 0) AS `diaryCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `content_photo` WHERE `author_id` = #{userId} AND `deleted` = 0) AS `photoCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `content_video` WHERE `uploader_id` = #{userId} AND `deleted` = 0) AS `videoCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `content_book` WHERE `uploader_id` = #{userId} AND `deleted` = 0 AND `status` = 'PUBLISHED') AS `bookCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `content_wish` WHERE `requester_id` = #{userId}) AS `wishCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `family_task` WHERE `assignee_id` = #{userId} AND `status` = 'DONE') AS `taskDoneCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `family_game_record` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId}) AS `gameTotal`, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `game_code`) FROM `family_game_record` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId}) AS `gameDistinct`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `family_game_record` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `result` = 'WIN') AS `gameWin`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `family_game_record` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `source` = 'ROOM' AND `result` = 'WIN') AS `gameRoomWin`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `family_game_record` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `result` = 'WIN' AND `game_code` IN ('mahjong', 'mahjong3d')) AS `gameMahjongWin`, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`level`), 0) FROM `game_homestead_skill` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId}) AS `homesteadLevelSum`, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(`level`), 0) FROM `game_homestead_skill` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId}) AS `homesteadMaxLevel`, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`total_actions`), 0) FROM `game_homestead_player` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId}) AS `homesteadActionTotal`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `game_homestead_skill` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `level` > 1) AS `homesteadSkillOpened`

SELECT m.`user_id` AS `userId`, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`nickname`, ''), u.`username`) AS `name`, u.`avatar` AS `avatar`, COUNT(a.`id`) AS `unlocked`, COALESCE(SUM(a.`score`), 0) AS `score` FROM (SELECT DISTINCT `user_id` FROM `sys_user_role` WHERE `family_id` = #{familyId}) m JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.`id` = m.`user_id` AND u.`deleted` = 0 LEFT JOIN `family_achievement` a ON a.`user_id` = m.`user_id` GROUP BY m.`user_id`, u.`nickname`, u.`username`, u.`avatar` ORDER BY `score` DESC, `unlocked` DESC, m.`user_id` LIMIT #{limit}
